title: Visual Job
description: The compiled visual job record (AES-V2.7 / SUE-565). The durable knowledge is the semantic/artifact/reference/brand profile state; the compiled prompt is an output of that state, not the source of truth. This record carries the full lineage so a bad result routes back to the layer that produced it (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §5). See schemas/VISUAL-JOB-CONTRACT.md.

intent_ref.description: Editorial Intent this job traces to (schemas/editorial-intent.schema.json intent_id).

calibration_ref.description: The calibration version active when this job was compiled (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §6, §10 AES-V2.10). Nullable because calibration versioning may not yet be active; recorded explicitly either way so a later verdict is attributed to the calibration that produced it, not whichever is current.

package_ref.description: Editorial Package reference, when this job is planned from a package rather than a single article. Exactly one of article_ref/package_ref must be present — checked by scripts/compile-visual-prompt.mjs, not by this schema.

artifact_profile.description: One of the eight pinned visual artifact profile ids.

renderer.description: Full runtime lineage for the renderer layer (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §5 'renderer' routing layer). Model/provider drift is an editorial quality event even when semantic_spec, artifact_profile, audience, reference traits, and brand_profile are unchanged: recording runtime identity here — never inside compiled_prompt — is what lets a quality regression route to this layer instead of being misattributed to brand_profile or semantic_spec.

compiled_prompt.description: Deterministic string assembly from the declared inputs only. Absent when information_gain.verdict is skip.

compiled_from.description: Every input the compiled_prompt was assembled from. Required whenever compiled_prompt is present.

runtime.description: Renderer-layer lineage. tool/tool_version identify the rendering pipeline (e.g. a deterministic SVG compiler); provider/model/model_version identify the underlying generative runtime where one is used. Deterministic tools still record provider/model as the tool's own identity so the field is never blank. None of this may appear inside compiled_prompt — see context_isolation.

model_version.description: Exact model version or a dated model alias, so quality drift from a silent model swap is diagnosable.

quality_tier.description: Reasoning/quality tier, where the provider exposes one. Absent for tools with no such tier.

traits_applied.description: Which concrete audience adjustments were actually applied to this job, not the whole profile.

semantic_spec.description: What the image must communicate — the information, not the styling.

information_gain.description: Gate 1 (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §8; editorial/VISUAL-INFORMATION-GAIN.md). Cheap semantic preflight before any rendering. skip is a first-class, non-failing outcome.

verdict.description: proceed: the visual earns its place. skip: correctly deciding not to make the image — not an error.

density_check.description: Gate 2 (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §8; editorial/SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md; editorial/SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §2). The compiled job's semantic and visual density must match its artifact profile.

match.description: false means the job FAILS (e.g. a body infographic compiled at thumbnail density).

selected_reference_traits.description: Traits only, never a reference body (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §2).

authoritative_override.description: A reference trait listed here is the only way a reference may outrank the brand default, per editorial/profiles/brand/suengj-com.v1.json priority_rule.

context_isolation.description: Required allowlist, not optional. Models the fix for SUE-531 (built-in generative image attempts leaked unrelated recent project/conversation context into dashboard artwork).

excluded.description: Assertion that these categories were excluded from the compiled prompt. renderer_runtime_identity covers provider/model/model_version/quality_tier: that identity is lineage, not an input, and must never reach compiled_prompt text.
